mostWorthwhile.text: Growing the activated lymphocyte into antibody-making and memory cells was most worthwhile: it connected the immediate response with protection later.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the memory cells to the body before the later encounter was a little confusing; I expected to pair the cells directly with the returning bacteria.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the direct pairing failed and automatically added the cells to the body instead.

arbitrary.text: The body-assembly prerequisite felt somewhat arbitrary because the later bacteria already matched the memory cells, although the result showed where those cells persist.

continue.text: I would try another chapter: following the matching shapes from recognition to clearance and memory was satisfying, even though the required body-assembly step was not obvious.
